neighbours.label: the press-release opening formula: ' today' in 'Company, today announced/issued' and the dateline's closing parenthesis '(City, Date) —'
fire: Brightline Robotics, a leading provider of warehouse automation systems, today announced the opening of a new facility in Ohio.
SAN DIEGO, CA—(March 3, 2021) – Harborview Labs, a developer of water filtration technology, has closed a Series B round.
Northwind Foods Inc. (NASDAQ: NWFD), a maker of frozen meals, today issued the following statement regarding the recall.
Global payments firm Corvexa announced today that it has acquired a small fintech startup based in Lisbon.
AUSTIN, Texas (June 14, 2018) — Pinecrest Software, a leader in school scheduling tools, launched its new mobile app.
Meridian Health Partners, the largest independent clinic network in the region, today announced a partnership with two universities.
The National Park Foundation announced today that it will fund twelve new trail restoration projects.
Solano Energy, a provider of residential solar panels, today reported record revenue for the third quarter.
quiet: Brightline Robotics, a maker of warehouse automation systems, opened a new facility in Ohio last spring, according to local reports.
Harborview Labs, a developer of water filtration technology in San Diego, closed a Series B round in March of 2021.
I went to the store today and noticed that the frozen meals from Northwind were missing from the shelves.
Corvexa, a global payments firm, bought a small fintech startup based in Lisbon, the newspaper reported.
Pinecrest Software, an Austin company that makes school scheduling tools, released a mobile app in the summer of 2018.
Meridian Health Partners runs the largest independent clinic network in the region and works with two universities.
The kids spent today hiking a trail that the National Park Foundation helped restore years ago.
Solano Energy, which sells residential solar panels, had a good third quarter, analysts said in their notes.

notes: Top 32: ' today' x10, ')' x7, ' announced' x4, all in wire-service press-release openings. Near misses keep business news but drop the formula (no 'today announced', no dateline parenthesis); some keep the word 'today' in ordinary narrative.
